An interesting argument for using crypto wallets as universal paid API keys. The author goes even further to say that you could vibe code an app with paid APIs without even knowing which APIs you are calling. On one hand this sounds far more flexible than the status quo for payment information collection. On the other, I’m not sure provides like Lovable or Val Town will be incentivized to have their agents wire up users’ vibe coded apps to the cheapest APIs but would likely use their “preferred” APIs that benefit the platform most.
